name: mimic3-benchmarks-irit
description: A set of benchmark tasks built on the MIMIC-III clinical dataset that measure predictive performance for common ICU problems (e.g., mortality, length-of-stay, phenotype/multilabel classification). Tasks typically require modeling time-series and structured EHR data and evaluate clinical prediction quality.
evaluation_method: AUROC / AUPRC (standard discrimination metrics for clinical prediction)
reputation: Based on the widely used MIMIC-III dataset; commonly used in clinical ML research for ICU prediction benchmarks.
